ca-prop13-1978.bill: People's Initiative to Limit Property Taxation
ca-prop13-1978.leverage_point: Residents can use Prop 13 to question property tax allocations and advocate for or against changes to local tax rates or assessments during budget hearings.
ca-prop13-1978.summary: Proposition 13 capped property tax rates at 1% of assessed value and limited annual increases in assessed value, fundamentally restricting local government property tax revenue.

ca-ab195-2017.leverage_point: Residents can use AB 195 to demand clear, accessible information about proposed local taxes and ensure ballot language is transparent during budget and election cycles.
ca-ab195-2017.summary: AB 195 requires local ballot measures proposing taxes to include the rate, duration, and use of revenue in the ballot question, increasing transparency for voters.

ca-sb231-2017.leverage_point: Residents can use SB 231 to advocate for or against local stormwater and infrastructure fees, and participate in public hearings on related budget allocations.
ca-sb231-2017.summary: SB 231 clarifies that stormwater projects can be funded as 'sewer' services under Proposition 218, allowing local governments to finance infrastructure with less restrictive voter approval.

ca-ab1484-2022.bill: Local Government: Budget Transparency and Accountability
ca-ab1484-2022.leverage_point: Residents can use AB 1484 to review, analyze, and comment on local budgets, and demand accountability at public budget hearings.
ca-ab1484-2022.summary: AB 1484 requires cities and counties to post their adopted budgets and supporting documents online in a machine-readable format, enhancing public access and participation.

ca-ab1912-2018.bill: Joint Powers Authorities: Liability for Retirement Obligations
ca-ab1912-2018.leverage_point: Residents can use AB 1912 to question local agencies about pension liabilities and demand prudent fiscal management during budget hearings.
ca-ab1912-2018.summary: AB 1912 makes member agencies of Joint Powers Authorities jointly liable for pension obligations, increasing fiscal responsibility and transparency regarding public retirement costs.

ca-prop19-2020.bill: The Home Protection for Seniors, Severely Disabled, Families, and Victims of Wildfire or Natural Disasters Act
ca-prop19-2020.leverage_point: Residents can use Prop 19 to discuss property tax revenue impacts and advocate for local spending priorities at budget hearings.
ca-prop19-2020.summary: Proposition 19 changes rules for property tax transfers and inheritance, impacting local property tax revenues and the distribution of funds for fire protection and schools.
